name: Mei Taimi
source:
A sweet young woman who greets Seraphina at the palace. Sweetly voiced and cheerful, Mei seeks Seraphina's attention and friendship right from the get-go. Mei is perfect in every sense of the word, winning contests and being a natural at everything she tries. Her beauty is said to be only rivaled by her kindness. She looks to help Seraphina when she can and hopes to be someone for Seraphina to confide in about Angelo and Azreal.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
